nodes.text: Create a sparse winter settlement beside a frozen lake in a broad snowy basin at warm hazy sunset. Group roughly three ten-story apartment slabs and about five smaller four- or five-story brick blocks along one shore, loosely arranged around access roads and open courtyards. Run a cracked asphalt road past the buildings and along the lake, then across the frozen water on a long low bridge. Add segmented concrete fencing, isolated cottages, chimneys, antennas, and occasional warm windows. Keep the central landscape mostly undeveloped, with rolling snowbanks, gullies, shrubs, and dark openings in the ice. Place snow-laden birch and pine near the settlement and thicker forest on enclosing hills.
